segments.name: Autonomous mobile robots
segments.description: Builds autonomous mobile robots, operating software and control units for government and real estate clients.
segments.evidence: We specialize in the development and integration of AMRs, operating software, and electronic control units and power storage units.

revenueModel.text: Government entities and large real estate developers are the clients, with projects funded on a client-specific basis.
revenueModel.evidence: Operating on a business model that emphasizes collaboration and shared R&D, Micropolis strategically opts for client-specific funding as a means to avoid share dilution.
